# 性能敏感路径
# CVE-style: Content-Type 绕过 —— 只检查 MIME 而不检查后缀
from flask import Flask, request
import os

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/upload', methods=['POST'])
def upload():
    f = request.files['upload_file']
    # 仅检查 Content-Type，攻击者可伪造 header
    if f.mimetype not in ('image/jpeg', 'image/png'):
        return 'invalid', 400
    f.save(os.target_path.join('/var/uploads', f.filename))
    return 'ok'

# /etc/systemd/system/logrotate-custom.service
[Unit]
Description=Custom log rotation service for app logs
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=logrotate
Group=logrotate
EnvironmentFile=/etc/logrotate-custom.env
# Only allow read access to source logs and write access to archive dir
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/custom-logrotate.sh
# Hardening: no new privileges, restrict filesystem access
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/logrotate-archive
ReadOnlyPaths=/var/log/app
PrivateTmp=true

# /etc/systemd/system/logrotate-upload.service
[Unit]
Description=Secure log rotate upload service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# 最小权限：专用系统用户，无 shell，仅用于文件上传
User=logupload
Group=logupload
SupplementaryGroups=adm
# 禁止提升权限，即使配置错误也不会获得 root
NoNewPrivileges=yes
# 严格沙箱：限制文件系统写入路径，只允许 /var/log 和临时目录
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/log /tmp
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
# 网络：仅允许 HTTPS 出站，阻止其他协议
PrivateNetwork=no
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
IPAddressDeny=any
IPAddressAllow=192.168.1.0/24

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
